key_insight: MatCreatioNN combines reinforcement-learning MOF generation with a multi-stage CGCNN screening funnel to rapidly discover photocatalysts optimized for environmental remediation and CO2 conversion.
engineering_relevance: The framework shows how AI can cut computational screening cost while preserving accuracy, helping engineers prioritize synthesizable MOFs with improved light absorption, redox behavior, and stability.
method: Generated 120,000 MOF candidates with reinforcement learning
Screened 13 photocatalyst descriptors using a multi-stage CGCNN funnel
Ranked top structures by predicted photocatalytic fitness and synthesizability
evidence_signal: The funnel reduced computational cost by 4.13-fold, and the top Cr- and Zn-based MOFs outperformed PCN-224(Zr) by 1.70±0.25 and 1.20±0.05 fold, respectively.
watch_item: Predictions still require experimental validation, and performance may depend on the quality and coverage of the training data and descriptor set.
paper_title: MatCreatioNN: Machine learning-guided computational discovery of photocatalysts for environmental applications
